'''Gwig''' was a legendary scout from [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology that tracked the sun to its hiding place. "Gwig" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Gwig|the wokling]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|packtype=Stuffed Figure|pack=Zephee|altlink=https://archive.org/details/star-wars-collections-return-of-the-jedi-catalog-kenner-1982/mode/2up}}</ref>
